info.title: umbraco17-check: what blocks this Umbraco site from moving to Umbraco 17 LTS?
info.description: Scans an Umbraco 13 solution and tells you in seconds what blocks the move to Umbraco 17 LTS (Umbraco 13 reaches end of life on 2026-12-14): community packages with no Umbraco 17 release, AngularJS backoffice plugins that must be rewritten as Web Components, removed property editors and macros, and a curated list of Umbraco 14-17 breaking changes found in your code.
